_comment: Floor layout (see include/FloorGen.h). The floor is a grid of tiles that starts solid; rooms from config/rooms/*.room are stamped into it and connected with corridors. room_attempts is how many placements are tried before giving up, room_target how many are wanted. corridor_half: a corridor is (2*half + 1) tiles wide. tile_visuals gives each tile id a flat colour; with no tileset_path the renderer draws flat quads, which is what the art-less skeleton wants.
